sentences.en: China has landed their first jet on an aircraft carrier.
sentences.zh: 中国已经在一艘航空母舰上成功降落了他们的第一架喷气式飞机。

sentences.en: We can use the cat carrier for a small dog.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用猫笼来装一只小型的狗。

sentences.en: The Russians could destroy US aircraft carriers with hypersonic weapons.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人可以用高超音速武器摧毁美国的航空母舰。
